metadata.title: Retro Glamour Portrait with Swash Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A tight, profile-oriented portrait of a woman with 1960s glamour styling, featuring high-contrast swash typography in the upper right corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, three-quarter profile portrait of a woman with dark hair and dramatic winged eyeliner against a warm, textured mustard-gold background, balanced by a stacked block of decorative swash lettering in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed toward the right edge, leading the eye to the typography
Dark, voluminous hair providing a heavy visual weight on the left
High-contrast white and purple text against a warm ochre backdrop
Tight framing that emphasizes facial features and makeup detail
coreInvariants: Mustard-yellow or ochre background with subtle vignette
Dramatic 1960s winged eyeliner and defined brows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the neck and crown.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye and the dark mass of hair on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the dark hair, moves across the face following the gaze, and settles on the text block in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited to the upper right corner around the text and the right-side background.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between skin/text and hair; medium saturation in the background.

letterConstructionRules: Ball terminals on ascenders and descenders
Interlocking swashes that connect lines of text
Tight letter spacing with some overlapping characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Curled entry strokes on capital letters

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the negative space created by the subject's gaze

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast a white swash title with a colored swash subtitle in the same family.
graphicDevices: Small circular logo icon below text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 1960s/70s decorative serif aesthetic with heavy swashes.
Provides the correct period-accurate high-contrast serif feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a tight 1960s-style portrait of a woman with dark hair and winged eyeliner against a mustard-yellow background, leaving the upper right corner clear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add stacked title text in a bold swash serif font in the upper right, using white for the top lines and purple for the bottom lines.

verificationChecks: Is the eyeliner sharp and winged?
Does the typography feature interlocking swashes?
Is the background a warm ochre/mustard tone?
Is the text right-aligned in the upper corner?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure hair has visible texture and volume
Verify swashes do not obscure legibility
Check that the gaze leads to the text
Confirm the color palette feels mid-century
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Mustard Background + Swash Serif Typography in Upper Right
